name: 曲名と保存操作
prompt:
Create one Japanese now-playing metadata row at exactly 359x64 px. Match the supplied Japanese copy and native node 3 layout. Use a pure white #FFFFFF surface, title “いつもの光” in Meiryo Bold 20 px / 28 px line height / #1D1D1D, and subtitle “灯りの音楽隊” in Meiryo Regular 14 px / 24 px line height / #6E6E6E. Keep tracking at zero. Place the close X at the native right-side position and draw both the X and the outlined plus-circle in slate #526173. The plus-circle is a neutral, unselected secondary action, so do not use a green fill, green gradient or mint tint.

Preserve the simple left text stack and two right-side controls. Return the row alone, edge-to-edge at 359x64. Do not add a phone frame, status bar, album art, playback timeline, other controls, extra text, texture, shadow or gradient. The original source crop supplies row anatomy and action silhouettes. The Japanese preview and native file supply exact localized wording, frame and typography; current DESIGN.md supplies the white and slate palette.
reviewNotes: Selected attempt 1 after comparing both raw attempts: at width 359 with aspect preserved it is 359x161, versus attempt 2 at 359x200, so it is closer to the target 359x64. Both attempts retain the Japanese title/artist and white surface with slate X/plus-circle. Attempt 1 still has large blank vertical margins and remains needs-correction. Stored the raw image without crop or stretch; attempt 2 remains preserved as version 1.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
